notes:
Quick inbound from early-stage B2B SaaS (in-app help/chat for SMB SaaS apps). Team: CEO Maya Lin (founder), Eng lead Tomas Alvarez, infra lead Rina Okafor. Primary ask: replace brittle rule-based chat with inexpensive streaming assistant inside their web app. Latency is the #1 concern — they want a snappy typing experience (streaming tokens, <200ms perceived latency on chat startup and token arrival). Interested in Redwood hosted_api for speed to production; strong preference for public cloud (AWS us-east) and using Redwood-managed models to avoid infra ops.

Notes from call: "We need the assistant to feel instant — users should see tokens streaming as they type; anything that batches and adds delay is a non-starter." — Maya. They expect average session length ~5-10 turns, context window per session ~4-6k tokens (document + conversation). Cost sensitivity high — small ARR, want predictable per-token pricing and easy throttles for free tier.

Security: require SSO for admin console (SAML), audit logs for user-level API keys, and SOC2 compliance proof before paying. Also asked about retention controls (7/30/90 day options) and optional KMS for encryption at rest (deferred to mid-stage).

Technical details captured by SE: streaming via chunked HTTP or WebSocket acceptable; want sample React + websocket streaming SDK; need guidance on conversation cache TTL and prefix caching to reduce token costs; ask for recommended model/quantization combos for latency/cost tradeoffs. Suggested Redwood Optimize tips (batching config off for low-latency paths, prefix caching for static doc context).

Commercial: self-serve sign-up today; likely upgrade to pay-as-you-go once security check clears. ARR expected small (1-10k) first 12 months, potential to expand to Dedicated after product-market fit.

Action items: Jordan to send onboarding + streaming code sample, Priya to run quick hosted latency benchmark (p95) using a small test corpus, create security FAQ link, and schedule 20m follow-up for wk of 2026-03-17.
